title: Yatzeche Zapotec - Wikipedia
text: Yatzeche or Zegache Zapotec (Santa Inés Yatzeche Zapotec, Southeastern Zimatlán Zapotec) is a Zapotec language spoken in the Santa Ana Zegache and Santa Inés Yatzeche municipalities of Zimatlán District of Oaxaca, Mexico.

title: Yatzeche Zapotec — Grokipedia
text: Yatzeche Zapotec belongs to the Otomanguean language family, forming part of the Zapotecan branch that includes both Zapotec and Chatino languages.
